money: integer øre; every division truncates toward zero

materials.name: unit_ore
materials.note: ignored when sku is in the process-lifetime price book

rules: Resolve unit price from the in-memory price book when the SKU is known; otherwise use the line unit_ore.
If a line quantity is >= 10, apply a 5% volume discount to that line before markup (ore * 95 / 100).
If the sum of material quantities is < 3, force markup_bps to 0 (small-job exception).
Markup applies to materials only, never labor (materials_ore * markup_bps / 10000).
VAT is 25% of materials + labor + markup (net * 2500 / 10000).
